reviewer_role: Independent read-only code/reliability reviewer; neither source nor workflow author
scope: Source and workflow review only. No browser, HTTP/CI launch, model, Cargo, native experiment or complete LAB acceptance performed by reviewer.

B_variant.difference: ONLY readBytes function; bounded native pipeTo/WritableStream, no manual reader/lock release or unbounded fallback; all other module bytes identical.

source_findings.evidence: Native WritableStream.write increments length and checks the byte cap before chunks.push. Native pipeTo is awaited with its default backpressure, cancellation and lock release. The saved writeError is rethrown when a secondary cancellation rejection replaces the primary size error. No unbounded arrayBuffer fallback is introduced.

Before B starts, A must have mainSettled and pageClosed, zero pending callbacks and paused requests, zero cleanup errors, admitted sandbox/guard state, and zero global Node unhandled errors. Context and browser close promises are awaited through the error-preserving cleanup wrapper. Otherwise B is explicitly NOT_RUN and overall FAIL.

source_findings.claim: Actual original bodies and no substitution
source_findings.evidence: Request-stage Fetch interception is enabled before navigation. Only the eight literal loopback GET paths and fixed initial query are admitted; every other request is blocked before transmission. Response-stage Fetch.getResponseBody validates exact size/SHA and Content-Length/no Content-Encoding, followed by continueResponse containing requestId alone. No route/fulfill/second fetch or browser native Promise/Response/Reader observer is installed.

Each arm PASS requires eight unique Network/Fetch/server observations, loadingFinished for every admitted resource, exact original body hashes, continuation ACK after body completion, server GET200 completed and not aborted, ready initial/final UI, baseline seed1/tick0, 24 matrix rows, four visible plots, zero page/runtime/console/Node/callback/cleanup/request errors, settled main, closed page and zero pending work. Owned observations are revalidated again after both arms.

Candidate eligibility permits failed native requests only among the four original data JSON files: full decoded count equals the exact pin, one canceled ERR_ABORTED with no blockedReason and one matching Playwright GET failure during main; all eight bodies, unchanged ACKs, server completions, exact initial/final UI and clean lifecycle remain mandatory. The helper never changes a failed arm or overall FAIL.

Official Playwright1.61.1 Chromium with chromiumSandbox:true and only enable-automation as added argument; observed argv must reject all eight sandbox bypasses plus ignore-gpu-blocklist and disable-web-security. No Debugger, forced GC, native Promise observers or extra causal cases. Each arm owns a new browser/context/page and bounded loopback server.
